'''Comline Six''' was the [[comline]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] used to communicate with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] while she was exploring [[Arbra/Legends|Arbra]] and he was in orbit of the planet in his [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]].
